cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
lines = open('edge_cases.py').read().split('\n')
# find the block from "# 11. stale worker blocks the step" to the results.append line
start = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('# 11. stale worker blocks the step'))
end = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if "results.append(('stale blocked'" in l)
new_block = """# 11. stale workers block the step (every seen worker ages past max_lag)
out = check(base(max_lag=0, workers=[[0], []],
                 commodities=[{'source': 0, 'sink': 1, 'demand': 4, 'paths': [[0]]}],
                 events=[{'op': 'issue', 'id': 1, 'worker': 0},
                         {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 1},
                         {'op': 'issue', 'id': 2, 'worker': 1},
                         {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 2}, {'op': 'step'}, {'op': 'step'}]))
assert '"missing":[],"stale":[0,1],"fresh":[]' in out, out[:400]
results.append(('all stale blocked', 'stale [0,1]'))

# 11b. exactly one stale worker
out = check(base(max_lag=1, workers=[[0], []],
                 commodities=[{'source': 0, 'sink': 1, 'demand': 4, 'paths': [[0]]}],
                 events=[{'op': 'issue', 'id': 1, 'worker': 0},
                         {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 1},
                         {'op': 'issue', 'id': 2, 'worker': 1},
                         {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 2}, {'op': 'step'},
                         {'op': 'issue', 'id': 3, 'worker': 0},
                         {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 3}, {'op': 'step'}, {'op': 'step'}]))
assert '"missing":[],"stale":[1],"fresh":[]' in out, out[:500]
results.append(('one stale worker', 'stale [1]'))"""
lines[start:end+1] = new_block.split('\n')
open('edge_cases.py','w').write('\n'.join(lines))
PYEOF
